name: application-signals
description: Use CloudWatch Application Signals for comprehensive observability of your cloud-based applications.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-instrumentation-configurations
subcommands.description: Deletes multiple instrumentation configurations in a single request.

subcommands.name: batch-get-service-level-objective-budget-report
subcommands.description: Use this operation to retrieve one or more service level objective (SLO) budget reports.

subcommands.name: batch-update-exclusion-windows
subcommands.description: Add or remove time window exclusions for one or more Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

subcommands.name: create-instrumentation-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a dynamic instrumentation configuration for a specific code or endpoint location within a service and environment.

subcommands.name: create-service-level-objective
subcommands.description: Creates a service level objective (SLO), which can help you ensure that your critical business operations are meeting customer expectations.

subcommands.name: delete-grouping-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the grouping configuration for this account.

subcommands.name: delete-instrumentation-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified instrumentation configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-service-level-objective
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified service level objective.

subcommands.name: get-instrumentation-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the details of a single instrumentation configuration identified by service, environment, signal type, and location.

subcommands.name: get-instrumentation-configuration-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status history for a single instrumentation configuration during a specified time range.

subcommands.name: get-service
subcommands.description: Returns information about a service discovered by Application Signals.

subcommands.name: get-service-level-objective
subcommands.description: Returns information about one SLO created in the account.

subcommands.name: list-audit-findings
subcommands.description: Returns a list of audit findings that provide automated analysis of service behavior and root cause analysis.

subcommands.name: list-entity-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of change events for a specific entity, such as deployments, configuration changes, or other state-changing activities.

subcommands.name: list-grouping-attribute-definitions
subcommands.description: Returns the current grouping configuration for this account, including all custom grouping attribute definitions that have been configured.

subcommands.name: list-instrumentation-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns all active instrumentation configurations for a service and environment.

subcommands.name: list-service-dependencies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of service dependencies of the service that you specify.

subcommands.name: list-service-dependents
subcommands.description: Returns the list of dependents that invoked the specified service during the provided time range.

subcommands.name: list-service-level-objective-exclusion-windows
subcommands.description: Retrieves all exclusion windows configured for a specific SLO.

subcommands.name: list-service-level-objectives
subcommands.description: Returns a list of SLOs created in this account.

subcommands.name: list-service-operations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the operations of this service that have been discovered by Application Signals.

subcommands.name: list-service-states
subcommands.description: Returns information about the last deployment and other change states of services.

subcommands.name: list-services
subcommands.description: Returns a list of services that have been discovered by Application Signals.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Displays the tags associated with a CloudWatch resource.

subcommands.name: put-grouping-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the grouping configuration for this account.

subcommands.name: report-instrumentation-configuration-status
subcommands.description: Reports the status of one or more instrumentation configurations from SDK instances.

subcommands.name: start-discovery
subcommands.description: Enables this Amazon Web Services account to be able to use CloudWatch Application Signals by creating the AWSServiceRoleForCloudWatchApplicationSignals service-linked role.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified CloudWatch resource, such as a service level objective.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-service-level-objective
subcommands.description: Updates an existing service level objective (SLO).
